new_candidates.maker: Infineon Technologies (datasheet OPTIREG linear TLE42754 Rev. 1.31, 2023-11-27); S1 Infineon
new_candidates.placements_basis: fixed at 1: one excitation for the 3 bridges and the ADC's AVDD (F3, V254)

requirements.name: output voltage
requirements.required: 5.0 V nominal, held within 4.75 to 5.25 V over input 6.0 to 22 V, load 0 to 60 mA and 0 to 50 °C ambient, because it is also the bridge ADC's AVDD
requirements.datasheet: The datasheet gives VQ 4.9 to 5.1 V for 1 mA < IQ < 400 mA and 6 V < VI < 28 V, over Tj −40 to 150 °C (Table 5, P_5.1.2). That is inside 4.75 to 5.25 V. Two conditions apply. First, loads below 1 mA are not specified, so the pass holds with a preload of at least 1 mA on the output. A 4.7 kΩ ±1 % resistor draws 1.03 mA at 4.9 V and 1.10 mA at 5.1 V and dissipates 5.6 mW, which keeps IQ above 1 mA while the bridges and the ADC draw 0 to 60 mA. Second, 6.0 V is the open end of '6 V < VI'. At 6.0 V the input is 0.9 V above the output, above the 0.5 V maximum dropout at 300 mA (P_5.1.7)

requirements.name: output current
requirements.required: at least 60 mA continuous: 3 bridges of 345 Ω at 5.25 V draw 45.7 mA, plus up to 13.8 mA of analogue supply for a 2-placement bridge ADC (AD7190 2 × 6.75 mA, Rev. C; AD7195 2 × 6.9 mA, T4 re-rank reading)
requirements.datasheet: The band is specified to IQ < 400 mA (P_5.1.2), and the current limit is 450 to 1100 mA at VQ = 4.8 V (P_5.1.4). With the 1.10 mA preload the regulator carries at most 61.1 mA

requirements.name: input voltage range
requirements.required: operates from 6.0 to 22 V: the selected input bus spans 6.0 to 20 V (R5 row; 2 cells at the 3.0 V floor of F9), and 22 V is the highest the DC input's cut-off may sit at (V84, open)
requirements.datasheet: Functional range VI 5.5 to 42 V (Table 3, P_4.2.1); absolute maximum VI −42 to 45 V (P_4.1.1)

requirements.name: dropout
requirements.required: at most 1.0 V at 60 mA, so the output stays in regulation from 6.0 V
requirements.datasheet: Vdr is 500 mV maximum at IQ = 300 mA, measured where VQ has dropped 100 mV from its value at VI = 13.5 V (P_5.1.7). No figure is given at 60 mA. The 300 mA maximum is below 1.0 V

requirements.name: junction temperature
requirements.required: junction temperature at or below the part's maximum operating junction temperature at 22 V in, 60 mA out and 50 °C ambient, from the datasheet's θJA and its ground current
requirements.datasheet: Tj max is 150 °C (P_4.2.4). RthJA is 27 K/W on a 2s2p board (P_4.3.2), 57 K/W on 1s0p with 300 mm² of copper (P_4.3.4) and 110 K/W on the bare footprint (P_4.3.3). Ground current is 220 µA maximum at 1 mA (P_5.2.2), 10 mA maximum at 250 mA (P_5.2.3) and 25 mA maximum at 400 mA (P_5.2.4); no figure is given at 60 mA. The pass element dissipates (22 − 4.9) V × 61.1 mA = 1.045 W, preload included. Taking 10 mA of ground current as the bound gives 1.265 W, so Tj is 84.1 °C on 2s2p, 122.1 °C on 1s0p with 300 mm², and 189 °C on the bare footprint, which fails. Without assuming any ground current at 60 mA, the headroom to 150 °C covers 121 mA of ground current at 22 V on 2s2p and 32 mA on 1s0p with 300 mm². Both are above the 25 mA maximum at 400 mA. Condition: the part needs a 2s2p board or at least 300 mm² of copper

requirements.name: output protection
requirements.required: internal current limit and thermal shutdown: the excitation leaves the board on the load-cell leads
requirements.datasheet: Output current limitation is 450 to 1100 mA at VQ = 4.8 V (P_5.1.4). Overtemperature shutdown is at 151 to 200 °C with 20 °C typical hysteresis (P_5.1.10, P_5.1.11). The features list also names reverse polarity protection

requirements.name: operating temperature
requirements.datasheet: Tj −40 to 150 °C (P_4.2.4); no ambient range is given; Tj is 84.1 °C (2s2p) or 122.1 °C (1s0p, 300 mm²) at 50 °C ambient, 22 V and 60 mA
